Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.driver

Class ConstraintDetails

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.driver.ConstraintDetails
@Internal public final class ConstraintDetails extends Object
Reads the constraint name and column names of a constraint failure.

PostgreSQL details come from the driver's structured server error, read by reflection so the core does not depend on the PostgreSQL driver; the free-text DETAIL is never parsed. SQLite details come from the fixed wording of its error text. Names are schema names, never values; a name longer than 128 characters or holding a control character is dropped. For an unnamed SQLite CHECK the key is the check's expression text, still schema and never a value. SQLite column lists are split on ", " and the first dot, so a name holding either is read wrongly; such names are rare and the result is at worst a wrong or missing column name.

API Note:
Internal: for drivers in this library.

    • sqlite

      public static ConstraintDetails sqlite(String message)
      Reads the details from SQLite error text.

      UNIQUE and NOT NULL failures give the columns after the table dot, a CHECK failure gives the constraint name as the key, a foreign key failure gives nothing.

      Parameters:
      message - the error text, may be null
      Returns:
      the details, never null
